scope: LoadingScreenRenderer producer capture and pending-request handover; local visual observations, not a calibrated full loading-screen acceptance gate
camera: N/A: all selected loading captures have worldPresent=false and worldTick=0
measurementWindow: clientTick=1, worldTick=0; producer swaps with presentedFrame=2..9, not post-world client ticks
limitations: No native Forge startup/mod-loading progress proof
World fixture PASSED is separate from loading visual observations
No performance or general cross-GPU pixel-parity claim
findings: The client-tick world-load dump cannot observe the synchronous launchIntegratedServer loop.
Actual LoadingScreenRenderer swaps draw Loading world text; normal world startup passes progress=-1, which requests no numeric bar.
An explicitly controlled progress=50 case draws both strings and a green 150x6-pixel bar (50x2 logical units at scale 3).
The pre-handover AMD leg requested eight producer captures but lost the first on VSync-driven wrapper replacement. The candidate preserves all eight on both GPUs.
currentScreen remains GuiMainMenu during these producer calls; that field alone does not identify the active draw producer.
worldGateVsLoading: The harness process/result PASSED verdicts below apply to the separate calibrated terrain picture, not to a calibrated loading gate.
